Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Bath hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 13 of the 18 Bath hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 5, Traveluro at 2, Vio.com at 2, Bluepillow.ar at 1, Catchit.com at 1, Evendo at 1 and The Kennard Bath at 1. These are the Bath rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Bath hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($26 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 17% at Hill House to 20% at Lansdown Grove Hotel. At 4 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
